tools.name: search_accidents
tools.description: Search the merged aviation-accident corpus (80+ official agencies, occurrence-level dedup). Filters: aircraft family slug (e.g. "boeing-737"), ISO alpha-2 country, occurrence type, operator substring, date range (from/to as YYYY-MM-DD), and fatal-only. Returns a page of occurrences with source-attri

tools.name: get_accident
tools.description: Fetch one occurrence by its FlightFinder id, with source-attribution links and references to the narratives available for it.

tools.name: get_narrative
tools.description: Fetch an investigation narrative by (source, case id). Open-licensed sources return full text; others return a ≤300-char excerpt plus a source_url deep link (per-source licensing policy). id URL-encoding is handled for you — pass the raw case id.

tools.name: aircraft_safety
tools.description: Aggregate safety statistics for an aircraft family: total occurrences, hull losses, fatal accidents, total fatalities, and first/latest year.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List every data source in the corpus with its license, homepage, narrative count, and republication policy (full vs excerpt).

tools.name: airport_reference
tools.description: Resolve an airport by ICAO ident or IATA code (OurAirports, CC0). Returns name, city, country, and coordinates.

tools.name: wildlife_strikes
tools.description: FAA National Wildlife Strike Database (US-government public domain). With no arguments: global totals, the full yearly series since 1990, and the leading airports, species and flight phases. Pass airport OR species for that breakdown. Slugs are lowercase and hyphenated (e.g. "kden", "mourning-dove")

tools.name: laser_incidents
tools.description: FAA Reported Laser Incidents — lasers aimed at aircraft (US-government public domain). With no arguments: national totals, injuries and the yearly series. Pass state OR airport for that breakdown, as a lowercase hyphenated slug.

tools.name: drone_sightings
tools.description: FAA UAS (drone) Sighting Reports filed by pilots and controllers (US-government public domain). With no arguments: national totals, the yearly series and the leading states and cities. Pass state for that breakdown, as a lowercase hyphenated slug.
